name: crab-progress
description: Mission Control for Claude Code: a HUD band above the prompt, a live agents pane (/missioncontrol), skins, pixel-art casts and Night City easter eggs.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en, ru or he (Hebrew, drawn right to left)

autoOpen.title: Open the agents panel
autoOpen.description: mission: when an mc-* worker starts or a plan is reported with the progress tool; any: also when any other subagent starts
